infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Solace uses the camera to scan food barcodes and photograph meals for AI-assisted logging.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Solace can use photos from your library to log a meal with AI-assisted recognition.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Solace uses the microphone so you can dictate a meal description using your keyboard's voice input.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Solace uses your location to record the route, distance and pace of GPS-based activities like running or cycling.
